purpose: Declare, for every historical report, its frozen bytes and whether the current generator still reproduces it. A drift that is not declared here fails the verification test that reads this file.

hashRules.frozenSha256: SHA-256 of the committed bytes, LF-normalized. Identity only: it says the file was not edited.
hashRules.observedSha256: SHA-256 of the generator's current output, excluding run metadata (generatedAt, environment). For a report with no run metadata this is its raw hash.

reports.promotion: not performed: the committed bytes are the R1 record
not performed: the committed bytes are the R33 offline record
not performed: the interface check is a convenience copy, not evidence

reports.cause: The committed file is a 2026-11-01 gate-refusal record (stage writer-only). Refusals are now written run-scoped under R33_RUN_ROOT and never replace a latest report, so no current command reproduces this path.
reports.promotion: not applicable: kept as the historical refusal record
